title: Integration of Contextual Descriptors in Ontology Alignment for Enrichment of Semantic Correspondence
reasoning: The paper uses the domain of AI ethics as its primary experimental case study. It specifically evaluates its ontology alignment method using ethical indicators and principles such as 'Responsibility', 'Justice & Fairness', 'Dignity', and 'Ethical Oversight', making ethics a core component of the benchmarking and evaluation process.
